name: Death
languages: all those of the creature who summoned it

traits.name: The Law of Death
traits.text:
At the start of each of
Death’s turns, undead within 10 feet of it take 10
force damage.

traits.name: Chaos Vulnerability
traits.text:
The Inexorables have disadvantage
on all saving throws against spells.

traits.name: Inexorable
traits.text:
The Inexorables are immune to any
effects that would slow them or deny them
actions or movement.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: Death’s innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 13). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components: * 3/day: death ward

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text:
Death makes three slam attacks
or makes one slam attack and one Death to
Undeath attack.

actions.name: Slam
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft.,
one target. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Death to Undeath
actions.text:
Death points at an undead
creature within 60 feet. The target must make
a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or take 33 (6d10)
force damage. On a successful save, the target
takes half that damage.
